children: US ground lease REIT's Q3 revenue beat analyst expectations
Q3 EPS was $0.41; no analyst estimate provided for comparison
Company closed $38 mln of new ground lease originations in Q3
Company says it is well-positioned with ample liquidity and no significant near-term maturities
GROUND LEASE ORIGINATIONS - Co closed $38 mln of new ground lease originations in Q3, including multifamily assets at what it described as attractive yields and low GLTVs
MARKET VOLATILITY - Co said recent rise in rates has added volatility to transaction markets
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the diversified reits peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Safehold Inc is $15.50, about 34.2% above its November 2 closing price of $11.55
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
